designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1980 to protect the salt marsh of the Tijuana River estuary; now part of the Tijuana River National Estuarine Research Reserve.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Tijuana Slough National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Tijuana River National Estuarine Research Reserve FAQ: Tijuana Slough National Wildlife Refuge (1980)

designationHistory.indexOriginal: The refuge was established in 1980 and is part of the 2,800-acre Tijuana River National Estuarine Research Reserve, one of only 30 such reserves in the United States.
